what: O2 macro blackout calendar (PREREG_HUNT_WIDE W 7.4a): FOMC policy-statement release times and US Employment Situation (nonfarm payrolls) release times, 2020-2026, in ET and UTC. Dates only: no market outcome was read to make it. research/hunt/reads_o.py uses it only when this file's line is in PREREG_HUNT_WIDE.sha256 with its sha256 and every event inside the read periods has verified_official true.
status: UNVERIFIED DRAFT: no official page could be fetched from the building session (the egress proxy denied CONNECT to www.federalreserve.gov and www.bls.gov; the fetch tool could not resolve them). Every date below was cross-checked only against search-engine excerpts of the official pages (field 'evidence'), or not at all where it says 'prior knowledge'. verified_official is false everywhere. To verify: open the two official pages named in 'how_to_verify', compare every date and time, set verified_official true on each event checked (fix any that differ), keep 'counts' equal to the events, then append this file's line to the pin before the read runs. A second (review) session found no wrong, missing or mistimed event inside the read periods against domain-restricted search excerpts of the official pages, but could not open them either.
how_to_verify: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm (2021-2027 meetings; each meeting's statement link and 'Released ... at 2:00 p.m.')
https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomchistorical2020.htm (2020, incl. the unscheduled meetings and the March 23 notation vote)
https://www.bls.gov/bls/news-release/empsit.htm (every past Employment Situation release; the file name empsit_MMDDYYYY is the release date; each release's first line gives the 8:30 a.m. ET embargo)
https://www.bls.gov/schedule/news_release/empsit.htm and https://www.bls.gov/bls/2025-lapse-revised-release-dates.htm (2025-2026 schedule and the rescheduled releases)
revision_note: review round: 2020 notation votes and the 2025 shutdown's original NFP dates added to 'excluded'; reference_month of the 2025-12-16 release set to 2025-11; evidence of the review session's official-page excerpts added (2020-03-23 08:00 EDT header, 14:00 headers 2023-2025, five 2020 NFP dates, 2026-12-04). No date or time changed; verified_official stays false.
dst_rule: US Eastern: EDT (UTC-4) from the second Sunday of March to the first Sunday of November (02:00 local), EST (UTC-5) otherwise; all listed times are after 02:00 local

definitions.FOMC: T = release time of the FOMC's post-meeting monetary policy statement (14:00 ET for every scheduled meeting of 2020-2026; the 2020 unscheduled meetings and the 2020-03-23 notation vote at their own release times); meeting_type scheduled / unscheduled / notation_vote
definitions.NFP: T = release time of the BLS Employment Situation news release (08:30 ET), on the actual release date (rescheduled dates where BLS moved a release)
